items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: The harness only goes to the task page when not already there, waits for the Launch button, and records a report step when the modal already launched the task; resume path unchanged.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: taskStateText never throws; an unknown or failed state keeps the old click path (fails with the usual timeout).

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Test harness only; no new input, exec or network.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Pure helper launchedByModal covered for launched, button present, failed and unknown states.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One extra state read only when no button shows.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Decision lives in driver.ts next to taskStateText; e2e.spec.ts stays thin.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Consumer of the WebUI task list state words; helper matches the words taskStateText already emits (probe: state awaiting_external_start and state active both match).
